text: Reference-only while within 30 feet of the hung tapestry: study it for 1 hour during a Long Rest, recording a d20 to replace one of your D20 Tests before rolling until your next Long Rest. It records a Dream caster’s name and appearance. While Unconscious, gain Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves.
